description: Native identity, as in the browser SDK. `identifyInstallation` makes a store that tracks as `*` track as a new anonymous visitor `anon:<UUID>` it keeps across launches. `identify` of an opaque account while the store tracks as a visitor queues one link between them, in order with the events; any other `identify` only changes the actor. `reset` tracks as `*` again and forgets the traits; `identifyInstallation` after it starts another visitor. Each case runs `steps` on a new store; `actor` is what later events carry (`visitor N` is the Nth visitor the case started) and `queue` the waiting rows, oldest first. A step with `error` changes nothing.

cases.name: an installation identity is a new visitor
the visitor survives another installation identity
identifying the visitor links it between the events
identifying the same account again links nothing
an installation identity keeps an identified account
without an installation identity nothing is linked
switching accounts without a visitor links nothing
after a reset the next account links a new visitor
identifying the anonymous actor links nothing
a visitor id cannot be identified

takes.description: A take is one link alone or a contiguous run of track rows that stops before a link; batch limits apply within the run.

request.description: A link is sent alone and uncompressed: `POST /v1/identify` with the write key as a bearer token, `Content-Type: application/json` and the body below.

outcomes.description: What the response to a link does to it: as a batch, except that 422 (the visitor is linked to another account) also refuses it.
